name: Liorae
summary: Liorae is crafted from precision-formed acrylic and stainless steel, combining clarity with strength in a pendant light of modern elegance. Its luminous body and polished accents create a balance of transparency and refinement, a design that glows with understated luxury. D800mm / D600mm Acrylic+Stainless Steel
